meaning:
ἀχρεόω (Rec. -ειόω, Polyb., LXX), -ῶ
(ἄχρεος = ἀχρεῖος) [in LXX (-ειόω) for אָלַח ni., etc. ;]
to make useless, unprofitable: pass., Rom.3:12 (LXX).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: They have all turned away. They have together become unprofitable. There is no one who does good, no, not so much as one.”
